object.name: evi_damp
object.digest: Onepole pass/shelf damping filters with simultaneous outputs
object.description: Two very efficient damping filters in parallel. A lowpass/highshelf filter (left outlet) and a highpass/lowshelf filter (right outlet). The frequency and damping inlets control both filters simultaneously for high level attenuation control. Useful for damping in reverbs and other situations. With the 'damp' inlet at 0.71..0.99 the first lowpass outlet is similar to MSP <o>onepole~</o> (depending on Hz).

inlets.name: frequency
inlets.digest: The center frequency around which the filters damp the input signal.

inlets.name: damp
inlets.digest: The amount of damping. A special normalised control: 0 = the filters are bypassed, 1 = the left filter is lowpassed and the right filter is highpassed. Between 0..1 the filters are attenuating shelves.

outlets.name: 6db
outlets.digest: Lowpass/Highshelf damped filter output. With damp 0.71..0.99 this outlet is similar to MSP [onepole~] (depending on Hz).

attributes.name: smoothdamp
attributes.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the damping input control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.

attributes.name: smoothfreq
attributes.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the frequency input control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
